description:
Secure collaboration and messaging

Element is a Matrix-based end-to-end encrypted messenger and secure collaboration app. It’s decentralized for digital sovereign self-hosting, or through a hosting service such as Element Matrix Services. Element operates on the open Matrix network to provide interoperability and easy connections.
✨ Features
- Copy changes for "set up recovery" (#35437). Contributed by @richvdh.
- Fix calls respawning from error screen on room switch. (#35470). Contributed by @toger5.
- Split ChangeRecoveryKeyBody out of ChangeRecoveryKey (#35403). Contributed by @kaylendog.
- Use a dialog to prompt the user about their recovery key when logging out (#35398). Contributed by @kaylendog.
- Remove introductory screen from "create recovery key" flow (#35451). Contributed by @richvdh.
- Don't allow to skip device verification by default (#35364). Contributed by @mxandreas.
- Remodel "Can't confirm" dialog to match designs (#35375). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Drop support for migrating libolm sessions (#35138). Contributed by @Half-Shot.
- Update Pill and PillInput design (#35370). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Offer 'Sign out' on the identity reset page if there is no other option (#35307). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Put user status below the avatar (#35328). Contributed by @dbkr.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Update Electron to pick up patches (#35573). Contributed by @t3chguy.
- Expand the device wildcard when a widget sends an encrypted to-device message (#35183). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Keep opening voice-only calls in PiP when the lobby is skipped (#35495). Contributed by @Johennes.
- Fix /spoiler command not converting markdown to HTML (#35103). Contributed by @jasonjose007.
- Open a call that is already in progress maximised, even for voice (#35443). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Fix guest login in oidc flow (#35432). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Avoid unhandled promise rejection from CallStore.onReady() (#34861). Contributed by @hughns.
- Add border around user profile avatar (#35460). Contributed by @dbkr.
- Fix PiP drag bar when displaying over widgets (#35395). Contributed by @mgcm.
- Feed thread replies to widgets (#35444). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Ensure 'Can't confirm?' is primary only if no other options are available (#35406). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Fix restricted guest module showing excluded UI elements (#35412). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Update compound-web to 10.3.1 (#35390). Contributed by @dbkr.
- Run DeviceListener rechecks one at a time (#35053). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Keep the new timeline at the bottom when its viewport changes height (#35374). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Stop writing removed legacy mention rules from the Labs notification settings (#35035). Contributed by @barodeur.
- Ellipsise long names in widget picture-in-picture view (#35329). Contributed by @robintown.
